market_question: Will the Republicans win the Maine Senate race in 2026?
reasoning: Maine has voted Democratic in recent presidential elections, but incumbent Republican Senator Susan Collins has a strong track record of winning reelection, including a 9-point victory in 2020 while Biden won the state by the same margin. If Collins runs in 2026, she starts as a toss-up or slight favorite; even with some chance of retirement, the true probability of a Republican win likely exceeds the implied 22.5%—closer to 40%.
evidence_points: Collins won 51%-42% in 2020 despite Biden's 54%-44% Maine victory.
Collins has never lost a Senate election and has held the seat since 1997.
The strongest potential Democratic challenger, Rep. Jared Golden, has not announced, and the field remains uncertain.
